}}Zurg is a Non-Player Character (NPC) in the game and is one of the antagonists in the Vriksha storyline arc. He is a disciple of Afla Dilith, one of the Four Fallen Gods.

==Debut Appearance==
<!--Gives an idea on what to add in, feel free to change what's needed and remove all this line.
Zebra first appeared in Elios Plains in Amdahl who suddenly ambushed the Summoner. It was thanks to Tilith, the Summoner was able to defend himself and later fled.
-->

==In the storyline==
<!--Gives an idea on what to add in, feel free to change what's needed and remove all this line.
Zebra was a disciple of {{c|Cardes|Cardes the Malevolent}}. In the past, Zebra framed [[Tora|another disciple of his Master]] with a false story about how she refused to join Cardes performing a wicked ritual. Cardes then banished that other disciple.

It is later revealed that Zebra was the one who annihilated most of the human population in the region of Palmyna after Cardes was sealed by the Four Heroes. He later decided to eradicate every remaining human while traveling throughout Grand Gaia.

Zebra has successfully lifted the [[Encervis:Final|Sky Fort Solaris]] in the island of Encervis and to use it as a weapon to eradicate everything in its path.

As the Summoner and it's allies reached the Sky Fort, Tilith was able to fight her but left her in a wounded state. The Summoner later defeats Zebra, not before he attempts to destroy the Sky Fort's mechanisms, hoping to send the Summoner and it's friends to their doom along with him. Not long before Elder Grah (later known to be Grahdens) was able to deal the finishing blow to Zebra, destroying him. And the Summoner and their friends was successfully rescued by Tilith with a glowing white light.
-->

==Personality==
<!--Gives an idea on what to add in, feel free to change what's needed and remove all this line.
Zebra is depicted as a ruthless disciple, who is willing to use dirty ways to get what he wants, as seen in how he framed [[Tora]] and when he lifted Sky Fort Solaris to eradicate everything in its path.
-->
